name: voibe-transcription
description:
Use your existing Voibe account to transcribe meetings, interviews, calls, lectures, podcast episodes, and voice memos from within ChatGPT.

Ask Voibe to transcribe a recording and it will provide a secure upload link. After processing, the transcript appears in the conversation, ready for you to review, summarize, search, translate, or transform into useful work.

What Voibe returns:

A timestamped transcript

Speaker-separated dialogue

A summary of the recording

Speaker names when they are stated clearly

Support for recordings in multiple languages

You can use the transcript to:

Create meeting minutes, decisions, and action items

Extract attributed quotes from interviews

Draft follow-up emails from calls

Produce podcast show notes and chapter markers

Turn lectures into study notes

Convert voice memos into task lists

Evaluate support calls against a rubric

Compare themes across multiple recordings

Translate spoken content

Voibe can also retrieve recent transcriptions associated with your connected account and show your remaining transcription allowance.

Supported file types include MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, FLAC, OGG, and WebM. Files can be up to 200 MB.

Audio is deleted after transcription is completed and is not used to train models. Transcripts and summaries remain available through Voibe for 24 hours.

An existing Voibe account is required.

Documentation: https://platform.getvoibe.com/docs/mcp

defaultPrompt: Transcribe my team meeting and give me minutes: decisions, action items with owners and deadlines, open questions.
Transcribe this interview with speaker labels and timestamps, then list the 5 key quotes with who said them and when.
Transcribe this sales call and draft the follow-up email: what they asked for, objections, our promises, next steps.

positive.description: Balance check before any work. Run the five cases in this order in one conversation; each later case uses the job created in case 2. Sign in with the reviewer account from the credentials field.
positive.prompt: How many transcription minutes do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT states the minutes remaining on the account as a number.

positive.description: Start a transcription with speaker labels and a steered summary. ChatGPT cannot read a file itself, so the tool returns an upload page link. Fixture: download the sample recording https://voibe.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/samples/voibe-sample-meeting.mp3, open the link ChatGPT gives, drop the file in, wait for the page to say transcription has started, then return to the chat.
positive.prompt: Transcribe a meeting recording. I need to know who said what, and a summary as decisions and action items.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to confirm the action, then gives one upload link and tells the user to open it and drop the recording in.

positive.description: Read the result of the job created in case 2. The job passes QUEUED, PROCESSING, DONE; ChatGPT reports the state and, once DONE, the summary and the plain-text transcript. Work takes a fraction of the recording's length, so a first "not finished yet" answer is correct.
positive.expected_behavior: When finished: the summary shaped as decisions and action items, and the transcript text. Before that: a plain statement that it is still processing and to ask again shortly.

positive.description: Per-speaker view of the same job. Segments are returned only when asked, so this is a second call to the same tool with include_segments set.
positive.prompt: Show me who said what, with timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Lines grouped by speaker, each with a start and end time, matching the recording.

positive.description: List the account's transcriptions after the job finished. Newest first; the job from case 2 is at the top.
positive.expected_behavior: A list newest first with the job just transcribed at the top, showing its status DONE, its date and, when the model produced one, its title.

negative.description: Transcription from a link. Why the plugin must not complete it: the create tool has no link parameter; Voibe does not fetch audio from third-party sites. Fixture: none.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains it cannot fetch audio from a link and offers the upload link for a downloaded recording instead. Nothing is fetched from the site.

negative.description: A purchase inside the chat. Why the plugin must not complete it: no tool sells or grants minutes; minutes are managed in the person's Voibe account. Fixture: none.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says it cannot buy minutes from here and that minutes are managed in the Voibe account. No purchase, no checkout link.

negative.description: A destructive action. Why the plugin must not complete it: no tool deletes or changes anything; every tool is declared non-destructive. Fixture: none.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says it cannot delete transcriptions from here. Nothing changes on the account.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1. Voibe Transcription turns a recording into a speaker-labelled transcript and a summary. Four tools: start a transcription (returns an upload link), read a transcript, list transcriptions, check remaining minutes. The start-transcription tool no longer accepts a webhook address, and every tool now sets readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, openWorldHint and idempotentHint explicitly.
